title: RBAC v2 audit: event enrichment and cost-aware partitioning for SSO/SAML events
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add RBAC v2-aware enrichment to audit ingestion so SSO/SAML events and admin actions surface the policy delta and effective permission set; implement cost-aware partitioning and dynamic TTL rules to bound storage costs while preserving compliance data for queries and investigations.
acceptance_criteria: Audit ingest pipeline emits enriched records with: actor_id, actor_role_set_hash, rbac_policy_delta, sso_session_id, idp_name, and session_expiry in the event metadata.

New per-tenant partitioning strategy enforces a configurable hot-window (default 30d) and cold-window with dynamic TTL and sparse indexing so cold events are stored at lower cost but remain queryable for 365 days if retention required by tenant.
Cost guardrails: ingestion throttles when projected monthly storage > tenant quota, with documented fallback to store reduced event set (rollups) and backpressure metric emitted to billing/console.

No decrease in query correctness for standard security investigations: dashboard queries for authentication failures, privilege escalations, and SSO federation errors return identical results for the hot window and documented degraded results for cold data (with example queries in runbook).
Migration: backfill enriched fields for 90 days of audit events with a bounded, rate-limited job and verification checksums.
technical_notes: Enrichment service will subscribe to raw audit Kafka topic, call the RBAC service to compute policy delta and effective role hash, and enrich events before writing to audit-storage topic.

Partitioning strategy: primary shard key = tenant_id + event_type_bucket + day_bucket for hot window; cold window consolidated by tenant and month bucket with rollup documents that store aggregated counters for low-value events.
Indexing: high-cardinality fields (session_id, actor_email) stored in dense column with compression; for cold partitions use sparse indexes and disable fielddata to reduce memory footprint.

Cost controls: estimator calculates projected storage per tenant using incoming rate, average event size (post-enrichment), and retention config; when threshold crossed, set tenant to 'throttled' mode via feature-flagged path which drops debug-level events and keeps auth/privilege-critical events only.

Security: enrichment path must not call external network endpoints outside VPC; RBAC service calls require mTLS and role-bound credentials; enriched events must be written with server-side encryption using customer KMS when tenant opts in.
tasks: Design enrichment schema and field whitelist with PM/Compliance review
Implement enrich-worker (subscribe->enrich->produce) with resiliency and dead-letter queue
Add RBAC service endpoint to compute policy delta and effective roles (idempotent cache TTL 1h)
Implement partitioning logic in audit-writer and storage adapter
Add cost estimator and per-tenant quota enforcement; integrate with billing/console
Create migration job to backfill last 90 days with rate-limits and verification
E2E tests and perf benchmark for ingestion throughput and tail latency
Runbook and console alerts for throttles, backpressure, and migration progress
comments: 2026-02-16 Miguel Santos: Spike completed. Enrichment increases median event size by ~18% and CPU by ~8% under current RBAC lookup cache; cache hit rate the key optimization.
2026-02-22 Security review (K. Nguyen): Require KMS flag be respected for private tenants; ensure no PII is added beyond existing auditing policy.
2026-02-27 Design feedback (L. Moreno): Prefer explicit 'event_tier' field instead of boolean hot/cold to support future multi-tier storage.
2026-03-05 PM acceptance (R. O'Connor): Confirmed retention configurability per-tenant and UI hooks needed in Console for quota overrides.

2026-03-09 Eng review (Infra): Prototype shows partition count growth could exceed shard limit if we keep per-day per-tenant shards for 10k tenants; moving to per-tenant day buckets only for active tenants suggested.
migration_plan: Stage 1: deploy enrichment to mirror topic and run in shadow mode for 2 weeks; Stage 2: enable enriched write for non-sensitive tenants; Stage 3: run backfill job for 90 days at 5% max cluster ingest; Stage 4: promote partitioning policy and enable cost-quotas; each stage gated by perf SLA and storage projection checks.
retention_policy_update: Default hot window 30d, cold window 31-365d with monthly consolidation; tenants with compliance flag can opt for 3yr retention with dedicated coldstore; retention configurable via Console and API.
